paper_title: DARWIN: towards the ultimate dark matter detector
notes: DARWIN projection for solar axions and galactic ALPs via axio-electric effect (g_Ae, AxionElectron coupling). Figure 4 shows sensitivity curves but only XENON100 reference values are given numerically in text (g_ALP_Ae ~2e-12 for galactic ALPs 1-40 keV, g_solar_Ae > 7.7e-12). DARWIN projects ~2 orders of magnitude improvement for galactic ALPs (~1e-14) and ~1 order for solar axions, but no explicit numerical DARWIN limit values or tables are provided. Data points cannot be reliably extracted from text alone. DM density 0.3 GeV/cm^3 assumed for galactic ALP search. | read-vote N=3: ct=AxionElectron (3/3); no consensus curve, took most-points
